title: Benchmarking weakly-supervised deep learning pipelines for whole slide classification in computational pathology

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Artificial intelligence (AI) can extract visual information from histopathological slides and yield biological insight and clinical biomarkers.

evidence.text: Artificial intelligence (AI) can extract visual information from histopathological slides and yield biological insight and clinical biomarkers.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Benchmarking weakly-supervised deep learning pipelines for whole slide classification in computational pathology》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-5】We implemented and systematically compared six methods in six clinically relevant end-to-end prediction tasks using data from N=2980 patients for training with rigorous external validation.
